title: Comeback Car Soccer
core_verb: Drive into the ball to propel it into the opposing goal.
fantasy: A compact enclosed car-soccer arena with one player car, one scripted opponent car, one ball, two goals, and boost pads.
fail_state: The opponent score reaches 2 when the ball enters your goal, or the 90-second timer reaches zero while your score is not greater than the opponent score.
win_state: Starting behind 0-1, raise your score above the opponent score by putting the ball into the opposing goal twice before the timer expires.

interaction_tags.meaning: Scripted rival car that strikes the ball toward your goal and can block or ram the player car.
Danger zone; the ball entering it raises the opponent score to 2 and immediately loses the round.
Collectible pad that restores the car's finite boost meter.
Goal zone; each ball entry adds one to the player score, with the second entry producing a 2-1 winning lead.

notes: Rocket League's multiplayer 3v3 format is reduced to one player-controlled car versus one scripted opponent car in a 90-second comeback round starting at 0-1; the player must score twice to take the lead, while conceding one goal loses immediately.

scene.description: An enclosed pitch with transparent walls under blazing stadium lights, mirrored across the midline. Two glowing goal mouths at each end, orange boost pads on the ground, a kickoff circle at the centre, and wall boundaries that keep the oversized glowing ball in play. Moderate: open enough to build speed, with the boost pads as the only fixed landmarks.
